title: nf-ms-dda-comet pipeline parameters
description: Automated Nextflow workflow for processing data with comet, percolator and uploading to Limelight.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

fasta.description: Path to the FASTA file of protein sequences to search.
fasta.help_text: A local filesystem path or a PanoramaWeb WebDAV URL (any value beginning with 'https://' is downloaded from PanoramaWeb automatically).

spectra_dir.description: Directory containing the mzML or RAW files to search.
spectra_dir.help_text: A local directory path or a PanoramaWeb WebDAV URL. The directory is sniffed for '*.mzML' first, falling back to '*.raw'. PanoramaWeb URLs (beginning with 'https://') are downloaded automatically; multiple URLs may be given, one per line.

comet_params.description: Path to the Comet params file used for the search.
comet_params.help_text: A local filesystem path or a PanoramaWeb WebDAV URL (beginning with 'https://').

result_dir.description: Directory where pipeline results will be published.

report_dir.description: Directory where Nextflow execution reports (timeline, report, trace) will be written.

email.description: Email address to notify on workflow completion.
email.help_text: If set, a notification email is sent when the workflow finishes. Requires the 'mail' section of the config to be configured. If unset, no email is sent.

processing_options.title: Processing options
processing_options.description: Control how Comet results are post-processed.

process_separately.description: Post-process each Comet result separately rather than combining them.
process_separately.help_text: When true, each Comet result is run through Percolator (and uploaded to Limelight) as a separate search. When false (default), all Comet results are combined into a single Percolator run and uploaded to Limelight as a single search with sub-searches.

limelight_options.title: Limelight upload options
limelight_options.description: Options controlling upload of results to a Limelight server. Required Limelight options apply only when 'limelight_upload' is true.

limelight_upload.description: Upload the search results to Limelight.
limelight_upload.help_text: When true, the remaining limelight_* options apply. limelight_webapp_url, limelight_project_id, limelight_search_description, limelight_search_short_name and limelight_tags are all required when this is true.

limelight_webapp_url.description: URL of the Limelight instance to upload to.
limelight_webapp_url.help_text: Required when limelight_upload is true. Example: 'https://limelight.yeastrc.org/limelight'.

limelight_project_id.description: Limelight project ID to upload data into.

limelight_search_description.description: One-line description of the search shown in Limelight.

limelight_search_short_name.description: Brief one-word nickname for the search, used to label data in plots.

limelight_tags.description: Comma-delimited list of Limelight tags to apply to this search.
limelight_tags.help_text: Tags that don't yet exist are created. Tag categories may be given as 'category~tag' (e.g. 'treatment~control,organism~yeast'). Required when limelight_upload is true.

limelight_import_decoys.description: Import decoy hits into Limelight to enable target/decoy QC visualization.
limelight_import_decoys.help_text: Dramatically increases file sizes; only enable when needed.

limelight_entrapment_prefix.description: Protein name prefix marking entrapment decoys for Limelight QC.
limelight_entrapment_prefix.help_text: Any protein whose name begins with this string is treated by Limelight as an entrapment decoy (a target hit that is secretly a decoy), enabling error-estimation QC tools. Example: 'ENTRAP'.

caching_options.title: Caching options
caching_options.description: Locations used to cache expensive, reusable intermediate files across runs.

mzml_cache_directory.description: Directory where mzML files produced by msconvert are cached for reuse.
mzml_cache_directory.help_text: Set per execution profile (local path for standard/slurm, an s3:// path for AWS Batch).

panorama_cache_directory.description: Directory where RAW files downloaded from PanoramaWeb are cached for reuse.
panorama_cache_directory.help_text: Set per execution profile (local path for standard/slurm, an s3:// path for AWS Batch).

aws_options.title: AWS Batch options
aws_options.description: Options consulted only when running on AWS Batch (-profile aws).

aws_region.description: AWS region of the Batch queue and Secrets Manager.
aws_region.help_text: Used by the AWS Secrets Manager bridge when downloading from PanoramaWeb or uploading to Limelight on AWS Batch. Set by the 'aws' profile.

container_image_options.title: Container image options
container_image_options.description: Container image (with tag) used for each tool. Defaults live in container_images.config; override a tag to pin a different tool version.

images.description: Map of tool name to container image reference.
images.help_text: Each process selects its image via params.images.<key>. Override a value to run a different image/version for that tool. Keys not listed here are still permitted.
